info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Channel Activity Reviews Submission API
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of reviews related to channel activity analyses within banking operational services. It allows users to provide valuable feedback on various operational metrics, aiding in continuous improvement and service enhancement. Typical consumers include banking analysts and quality assurance teams focused on operational performance. By capturing insights through reviews, organizations can better address customer needs and optimize channel strategies.
